positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Manchester, New Hampshire, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
* Engineering team lead and scrum master for services during divestiture from a larger company
* Facilitated separation of many tightly integrated services between two companies
* Modernized services built for on-premises operation, migrating to cloud native processes
* Maintained services on a 24/7 basis
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET Core · DevOps

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Acted as an engineer and technical lead on a small team serving weather-related data for energy trading applications.
● Played a leading role in the effort to migrate product through ownership transition to a new company
● Maintained software managing global weather data from many sources on a continuously supported, 24/7 basis
● Conducted transition of products from an on-premises data center to multi-regional infrastructure in AWS
● Designed and developed software with a focus on speed, supportability, and high availability
● Worked in an Agile process, acting as scrum master and conducting planning and retrospective meetings.
● Managed both SQL and NoSQL databases to ensure performance and reliability needs are met
● Lead the effort to follow security best practices, respond to vulnerabilities and penetration testing results, and ensure compliance with applicable controls.

company.name: The Weather Company, an IBM Business

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Planning and developing enterprise software using Agile methodology
• Software development using C++ and Microsoft SQL Server
• Working as part of a team to review and approve sensitive changes to databases
• Maintaining and improving software in C# and ASP.NET
• Writing and maintaining utility scripts in vbscript and perl
• Working closely with QA in developing test plans and maintaining unit tests
• Assisting in research and prototyping of new product features

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Acting as a team member for the development of a telnet based online game.
• Contributing to software written in a proprietary language similar to C.
• Assisting the creation of software using PHP and MySQL.
• Using international communication for daily project coordination
• Using CVS and makefiles to manage source and build project
